about: Renders a box a person checks and unchecks, and the text that names it. A press anywhere on the row toggles the box.

align.about: The box's position against a label that wraps: on the first line, or halfway down the text.
align.title: Alignment

consent.about: A checkbox inside a field takes the field's required and invalid states, and its input lists the helper and error texts in `aria-describedby`. The field is invalid until the box is checked, so a press swaps the error text for the helper text.
consent.title: In a field

everything.about: `Checkbox.Group` holds the channels as one value. The box marked `parent` checks every value of `allValues`, and shows the partly-on state while some are checked. Press it to check all of them, and again to clear them. The channels start one box and one gap further in, under the parent's label.
everything.title: Select all

formats.helper: Pick every format the export should include.

size.about: The group at each size. The gaps between the rows and the indent under the parent box grow with the boxes, and every box takes the group's size.
size.title: Group sizes

inline.about: `orientation="horizontal"` runs the boxes in a row that wraps. The day names come from `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the reader's language.
inline.title: Horizontal group

limited.about: `maxSelectedValues` disables every unchecked box once three reports are pinned. Clear one to pick another. The count reads the value the example controls.
limited.title: Limit

long: Send me a summary of every invoice at the end of the week, with the totals and anything still unpaid

motion.about: How the mark enters when the box turns on.
motion.title: Motion

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The palette fills a checked box.
palette.title: Palettes

required.about: The form checks on submit that at least one format is picked. The fieldset is then invalid, every box reports it, and the error text is announced.
required.title: At least one

spread.about: A row at its own width, and a settings row that takes the width it is given with the box at the far end.
spread.title: Spread

states.about: Off, on, partly on and disabled, in every look. A partly-on box takes the look's fill, the same as a checked one.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the edge and overrides the palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Checkbox

variant.about: Every look at every size, each checked so the fill shows. The mark scales with the box.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
